messages:
mia: Heads-up — spotted weird per-chain unit costs in the chain-insights card. Chains with 3 model hops show lower per-token cost than any single hop.
otto: Whoa that's impossible unless cache attribution is being double-counted. Can you paste an example chain id?
mia: chain: convo-summarize-v2 (steps: embed->summarize->rerank). Window 2024-04-11T09:00Z. UI shows net $0.005/token but summarize step alone was $0.006/token.
rachel: Likely cause: cached prefixes counted as savings on both embed and summarize. Our telemetry currently zeroes compute for cached responses which subtracts tokens from denom at multiple hops.
sam: Also our chain weighting for unit cost is naive: we sum per-hop compute_ms and divide by final output tokens. For chains with heavy short-circuit cache hits upstream, denominator mismatch inflates apparent savings.
mia: Proposal: change chain unit-cost to compute the full end-to-end cost per output token where upstream cached hits contribute explicit cached_compute and cached_tokens fields instead of zeroing.
otto: API change debate: do we add per-request routing metadata (route_chain_id, hop_variant) to ingest? That will let us reconstruct exact per-request traces for accuracy, but increases ingest volume.
rachel: Maybe middle ground: emit per-request routing only for sampled requests (1:100) and per-window aggregated histograms for everyone. That gives high fidelity for debugging while keeping volume down.
sam: For the console UX I want a "chain breakdown" toggle on the unit-cost card that expands per-hop rows: cost_i, tokens_i, cached_tokens_i, quant_state_i. Cheap if backend returns compact histograms.
mia: Also add a "quota-aware routing hint": when tenant is near quota, show expected cost delta if we route hop-2 to a cheaper variant. e.g., "pin hop-2 -> summarize-small reduces unit cost by 12% but increases latency 40ms".
otto: That needs cost-sensitivity model: we can combine telemetry histograms + profiling table (cost per variant) to compute delta. Could be client-side when we return top-K variants and cost_i.
rachel: Agree. Implementation plan: (1) telemetry: add per-window chain_histogram: hopN_variant:count entries + cached_tokens per hop (INF-9001) (2) sampling: enable 1% per-request trace for chains over X QPS (INF-9002) (3) UI: chain-breakdown toggle + quota-hint button that simulates routing reweights (INF-9003).
sam: UX nuance: label everything non-billing "preview". Billing team requested that invoices continue to use the existing invoice-backed aggregation.
ops-bot: NOTE: INF-9001, INF-9002, INF-9003 tickets created.
billing-bot: Reminder: any change to invoice computation must go through billing@ and legal; UI previews ok.
